title: 8. Threat Hunting — Hypothesis-Driven
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L21: Threat Intelligence & MITRE ATT&CK: 8. Threat Hunting — Hypothesis-Driven.

blocks.text: Threat hunting is proactive search for adversaries already inside, before alerts fire.

items: Form hypothesis based on threat intel (e.g., "APT28 uses scheduled tasks for persistence — do we have any anomalous scheduled tasks?")
Collect data — query SIEM/EDR for the indicators of the technique
Investigate findings — escalate to IR or document as benign
Convert to detection — if you find anomalies, build a SIEM rule so future occurrences alert automatically

blocks.text: Hunt for TTPs, not just IOCs

items: Good: "find PowerShell processes spawning cmd.exe /c with base64 args that contact non-Microsoft domains" (TTP-level)
